name: Zachary Reese
event: UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs. Nolan
summary: Tall Texan finisher (10-4, 1 NC; 4-4 UFC) who lives in the first round: seven R1 stoppage wins and all three of his losses by stoppage came in R1. Comes off back-to-back losses - a disputed split decision to Michel Pereira and a 75-second TKO by Ryan Gandra.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long middleweight (196 cm reach) with explosive early offense: 20-second KO of Julian Marquez; mixes body kicks and hooks (Cageside Press). Out-landed Pereira 74-63 and Todorovic 50-35. Hands can drop as he throws - Gandra's dipping left hook over his guard ended it.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Opportunistic submissions: rear-naked choke of Jackson McVey in R2 on less than a week's notice (3 for 3 on takedowns), R1 subs of Aronov (DWCS) and Phillips. Gets taken down and controlled when he can't keep separation (Todorovic, Bekoev, Brundage).
how_they_fight.Defense: The weakness. Takedown defense about 47%; finished by Brundage (R1, after a takedown) and Bekoev (R1, ground strikes after over two minutes of control), and dropped by Gandra (R1). Sources say Pereira scored an early knockdown in February; our data records none.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fast starter, both ways. Eight stoppage wins: seven R1, one R2 (McVey). Three stoppage losses, all R1 (Brundage 1:49, Bekoev 3:04, Gandra 1:15). Has gone the distance three times (2-1), finishing strongly against Pereira per Rotowire, so the tank holds up when he survives R1. BJPenn.com: "tendency to get off to fast starts".
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Takes short-notice fights and accepts exchanges early; has been caught by counters when aggressive.

patterns: R1 is decisive either way: 7 R1 stoppage wins, 3 R1 stoppage losses
Competitive over 15 minutes when it gets there (Todorovic win, Pereira split)
concerns: Defensive lapses early: finished in R1 three times
Taken down and held by wrestlers (Bekoev, Todorovic)
keys_to_beat: Counter his early aggression with a hook as he comes in
Take him down and stay heavy in R1
If he survives R1, keep pace with him - he doesn't fade

news.text: TKO'd by Ryan Gandra at 1:15 of R1 (dropped by a left hook, then ground strikes) at UFC 329.
Lost a split decision to Michel Pereira in Houston that drew boos and robbery claims.
Booked against Mickey Gall at middleweight for Oct 31 (MMA Junkie).
